_comment: Tool arms for the generated-task harness (npm run harness). Each arm runs alone: its MCP server is the only one loaded (--strict-mcp-config), on top of the same built-in Read/Grep/Glob every arm gets. Placeholders: ${NODE} ${PROJECT_ROOT} ${REPO_DIR} ${TSCONFIG} ${RIE_DB}. `setup` names a preparation step the harness knows how to run before any agent starts.

baseline.description: No MCP server - built-in Read/Grep/Glob only.

rie.description: Repository Intelligence Engine, prebuilt index of the target repo.
